## Summary

Introduces `PersistentPipelineCache` in `crates/ramshared-vulkan/src/pipeline_cache.rs` to provide a defensive, RAII-based wrapper around `VkPipelineCache` with disk persistence. This enables caching compiled transfer compute shaders to disk, reducing startup latency and compilation overhead. It is exposed as a new module in `lib.rs`.

Exposed it via `pub mod pipeline_cache`.</details> |
